newsitem.title: CHINA: China central bank names new Shenzhen branch chief.
newsitem.headline: China central bank names new Shenzhen branch chief.

text.p: The People's Bank of China, the central bank, has appointed Jiang Chaoliang, director of its banking department, to be the new head of its branch in Shenzhen, bank officials said on Tuesday.
"It has been decided, there will be a announcement this afternoon," an official of the central bank's Shenzhen branch said by telephone from the booming southern city.
Central bank Governor Dai Xianglong was due to arrive in Shenzhen later on Tuesday to announce Jiang's appointment, the official said.
Jiang would replace Wang Xiyi as branch chief, he said.
An official at the central bank's head office in Beijing confirmed the appointment but declined to give details.
